GHK-Cu cream is a `topical skincare and anti-aging treatment formulated with the naturally occurring copper peptide complex` (glycyl-l-histidyl-l-lysine bound to copper).[[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/agelessrx-launches-ghk-cu-copper-130000816.html)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:12670512323771990955,catalogid:6117031215164847958,gpcid:4283367906397318322&ibp=oshop)

### What It Does & Benefits

- **Stimulates Collagen & Elastin:** Encourages the skin’s natural structural proteins to improve firmness, density, and elasticity.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4508379/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:12670512323771990955,catalogid:6117031215164847958,gpcid:4283367906397318322&ibp=oshop)
- **Softens Fine Lines & Wrinkles:** Helps smooth out photodamage, uneven texture, and surface lines.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4508379/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:2380187621595498973,catalogid:1972491592141884820,gpcid:18232328270889116321&ibp=oshop)
- **Supports Skin Barrier:** Provides deep hydration and works as a gentler alternative for people who cannot tolerate retinoids or strong acids.[[1]](https://www.allure.com/story/ghkcu-copper-peptide-skin-care-cream-compound)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:12670512323771990955,catalogid:6117031215164847958,gpcid:4283367906397318322&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:2380187621595498973,catalogid:1972491592141884820,gpcid:18232328270889116321&ibp=oshop)
- **Natural Blue Hue:** The signature blue or teal color comes directly from the copper-peptide complex itself rather than synthetic dyes.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/Neurogan-GHK-Cu-Copper-Peptide-Cream/dp/B0DRZ3P2SR)[[2]](https://fitish.com/products/ghk-cu-face-cream)

### Common Concentrations & Options

- **Over-the-Counter / General Moisturizers:** Ranging around 0.5% to 4% concentrations (such as options from [Neurogan Health](https://neuroganhealth.com/products/advanced-ghk-cu-copper-peptide-face-repair-cream) or [ANAiRUi](https://anairuicare.com/products/copper-peptides-cream)).[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:12670512323771990955,catalogid:6117031215164847958,gpcid:4283367906397318322&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:2380187621595498973,catalogid:1972491592141884820,gpcid:18232328270889116321&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:994057904649592942,catalogid:15045785140905558529,gpcid:12681957906873427343,mid:576462549878215765&ibp=oshop)
- **Prescription / Clinician-Guided Formulations:** Offered through platforms like AgelessRx or [Alloy Women's Health](https://www.myalloy.com/solutions/copper-peptide-cream-rx) with targeted percentages for midlife or reactive skin.[[1]](https://www.myalloy.com/solutions/copper-peptide-cream-rx)[[2]](https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/agelessrx-launches-ghk-cu-copper-130000816.html)

### How to Use

- **Application:** Cleanse and dry your face, then gently massage a pea-sized amount onto your face and neck.[[1]](https://fitish.com/products/ghk-cu-face-cream)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:12670512323771990955,catalogid:6117031215164847958,gpcid:4283367906397318322&ibp=oshop)
- **Frequency:** Can typically be used morning and night, though a patch test on the inner forearm is recommended first if you have sensitive skin.[[1]](https://fitish.com/products/ghk-cu-face-cream)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:2380187621595498973,catalogid:1972491592141884820,gpcid:18232328270889116321&ibp=oshop)
- **Routine Order:** Apply GHK-Cu before heavier creams or layer it carefully if combining with other actives like retinoids.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/Neurogan-GHK-Cu-Copper-Peptide-Cream/dp/B0DRZ3P2SR)[[2]](https://fitish.com/products/ghk-cu-face-cream)
